rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for the trait of treating people according to their wealth or status.

example.english: They judge people by their wealth; their snobbery is really strong.
example.traditional: 佢做人好睇人身家，真係好重勢利心。
example.jyutping: keoi5 zou6 jan4 hou2 tai2 jan4 san1 gaa1 zan1 hai6 hou2 cung5 sai3 lei6 sam1

rows.note: Use this when focusing on the person-oriented habit of judging or looking down on others by status.

example.english: Pretending not to see poor people is such snobbery; it is really hard to stand.
example.traditional: 見到窮人就扮睇唔到，呢種勢利眼真係好難頂。
example.jyutping: gin3 dou2 kung4 jan4 zau6 baan6 tai2 m4 dou3 ni1 zung2 sai3 lei6 ngaan5 zan1 hai6 hou2 naan4 ding2

rows.note: Use this fixed expression for the specific kind of snobbery that despises the poor and favours the rich.

example.english: His snobbery shows in how he ignores poor people but flatters the wealthy.
example.traditional: 佢一向嫌貧愛富，對窮人愛理不理，對有錢人就百般奉承。
example.jyutping: keoi5 jat1 hoeng3 jim4 pan4 oi3 fu3 deoi3 kung4 jan4 oi3 lei5 bat1 lei5 deoi3 jau5 cin2 jan4 zau6 baak3 bun1 fung6 sing4
